db_recalculation_comparison.note: Historical ETKDG/MMFF-or-UFF/XTB initial conformers; current generation uses diffusion coordinates. Not a matched geometry control.

condition_atom_count_sampler.source: checkpoint atom-count sampler; training-data distribution only

uncertainty.note: Single-run binomial descriptive interval, not checkpoint/seed reproducibility uncertainty.

definitions.target_hits: abs(Decimal(S1)-2*Decimal(T1)) <= 0.1 eV; energies as printed in logs
definitions.topology_screen: No RDKit perceived ring <=4 or >=9; 7 and 8 member rings remain allowed
definitions.geometry_screen: Original diffusion coordinates: bond/covalent-radii-sum between .65 and 1.4, nonbond ratio >=.65, aromatic-plane RMS <=.15 A
definitions.wbo_warning: Original heavy bond WBO<.3, new heavy contact WBO>.5, or old H bond WBO<.3 and new H bond WBO>.5
definitions.conservative_screen: Connected neutral closed-shell, original topology+geometry screens, optimization converged, no WBO warning
definitions.only56: All RDKit perceived rings 5 or 6 member; diagnostic restriction, not a chemical feasibility rule
definitions.novelty: Canonical nonstereo graph absent from this HP1KG train/val/test DB, not from all chemical databases
